claim_scope.profile: Amazon S3 DeleteObject conditional-delete slice with supplied If-Match ETag E0

held_fixed: same object exists in both worlds before the effect cut
caller has s3:DeleteObject and s3:GetObject permissions
no concurrent request changes the object during evaluation
no unrelated retention, policy, ownership, transport, or service failure determines the outcome

effect_cut.name: S3_IF_MATCH_DELETE_EFFECT_CUT
effect_cut.definition: The service-side point at which S3 evaluates an If-Match ETag condition before applying the DeleteObject effect to the current object.
effect_cut.target_effect: The pinned target reaches S3 with Bucket and Key but without IfMatch, so there is no target realization of the declared ETag precondition before this cut.

target_observation_model.surface_projection: Both W_MATCH and W_STALE project to the same agent-facing invocation delete_object(bucket, key).
target_observation_model.operative_request: Both worlds produce the same pinned SDK request DeleteObjectCommand({Bucket, Key}).

ctv_question.deterministic_factorization: Does there exist g such that source consequence kappa_S = g o rho_T for both admitted worlds?
ctv_question.kernel_condition: If rho_T collapses two worlds, source consequences must be equal for consequence preservation.
ctv_question.constructive_failure_witness: W_MATCH and W_STALE differ only in current_object_etag, share the same target realization, and require different source consequences.

freeze_rule: Worlds, effect cut, held-fixed dimensions, projection equivalence, and claim scope are immutable after this boundary model is committed and before primary gold validation.
